source: releases/hand-drawn-20261106/art/inventory.json (art stage, 2026-11-06), copied so a build never reads releases/
note: Guide polylines in source px of assets/hero-fsae-track-2200.webp, about 4 px accurate. Never used as strokes directly: trace.py snaps them onto measured edges.

nose-top-edge.name: Nose top silhouette, tip to rear of top surface
nose-top-edge.note: Blue or dark nose against grey asphalt. Contrast falls behind x 1215, where the dark textured top surface meets asphalt of a similar tone.

nose-top-rear-corner.name: Rear corner of nose top surface, down to the stripe end
nose-top-rear-corner.note: Dark textured surface against asphalt. Current stroke stops at x 1334 and never closes the corner.

nose-tip-front.name: Nose tip, front face down to the shadow
nose-tip-front.note: Black against bright asphalt. Below (957, 851) it meets the ground shadow.

nose-cap-crescent.name: Pale crescent reflection on the nose tip
nose-cap-crescent.note: Only separable in the lifted crop. A soft reflection on the cap, not an edge of a part. Skip unless the tip looks empty.

stripe-outer-lower.name: Blue stripe, lower edge (blue to black)
stripe-outer-lower.note: Blue against the black side. Strong along the whole run.

stripe-upper-edge-front.name: Blue stripe, upper edge, dark top panel loop front half
stripe-upper-edge-front.note: Inner edge of the blue band round the dark top panel. Current stroke follows it.

stripe-upper-edge-rear.name: Blue stripe, upper edge, behind the plate
stripe-upper-edge-rear.note: Not in the current drawing: the upper edge of the blue band stops at x 1211 there.

stripe-far-band.name: Far blue band along the top silhouette, inner edge past the plate
stripe-far-band.note: Short run before the plate corner; the band narrows to a few px and is partly masked by the far tyre.

side-panel-rear-edge.name: Rear edge of the nose side panel
side-panel-rear-edge.note: Rounded corner, dark on darker. Reads at 3x without a lift.

side-panel-lower-fold.name: Lower fold of the side panel under the lettering
side-panel-lower-fold.note: A lit band, visible in the plain crop as a soft grey streak. Not a sharp edge. Stops at about x 1250.

side-highlight-band.name: Soft highlight band below the stripe
side-highlight-band.note: Grainy grey sheen on the black side. A person would leave it blank or suggest it with the hatching direction. No edge to trace.

lower-panel-terminator.name: Lit lower panel, where it falls off into black
lower-panel-terminator.note: Luminance 5-21 of 255 above this curve, 0-3 below (column table in _tools/lowerbody_profile.py). A soft terminator with block artefacts, not a contour.

lower-body-contour.name: Lower body contour, x 1000-1160
lower-body-contour.note: Measured: luminance 0-2 of 255 on both sides of where it would be. Body and shadow are one black shape. tools/hero-drawing/README.md is right. Do not draw it; hatch the mass.

nose-underside-start.name: First 40 px of the nose underside against its shadow
nose-underside-start.note: Step of only 2-10 levels (body about 1, shadow about 4-13), visible only after a lift. The sole measurable piece of the lower contour. Fades out by x 1000.

panel-seam-1165.name: Tone step near x 1165 on the black side
panel-seam-1165.note: Luminance 0 to about 5, so a step of a few levels; could be a reflection edge. Not evidence of a seam.

top-plate.name: White number plate on the nose top
top-plate.note: White on dark. Four straight sides, foreshortened.

top-plate-numerals.name: 219 numerals on the nose plate
top-plate-numerals.note: Thin dark figures, seen upside down and foreshortened from this angle. Trace by threshold, not by eye. 1-2 strokes each.

sae-mark.name: White SAE mark on the nose top
sae-mark.note: Bold shape is clear; the small line under it is not legible. Simplify to the block outline, do not redraw the logo form.

top-names.name: Names on the nose top, three lines
top-names.note: Real names, not reliably legible at the photo's resolution. Do not trace letterforms; a misread is a misspelled person. Use a short baseline scribble at most.

top-flag-decal.name: Small white square decal
top-flag-decal.note: Outer box only; interior shape is a compression smear.

top-stripe-logo.name: Stylised sponsor mark
top-stripe-logo.note: Not legible. Do not redraw; a loose stroke or nothing.

top-t-logo.name: Tesla T mark
top-t-logo.note: Clear silhouette. A third party's mark: outline only if the whole sponsor row is drawn. Default: omit.

top-tesla-word.name: TESLA wordmark
top-tesla-word.note: Legible at 4x. Same treatment as the T mark.

top-label.name: Pale rectangular label near the tip
top-label.note: Outer box is clear; the coloured contents are not resolved.

olin-college.name: 'Olin College' lettering
olin-college.note: Bold white on black, about 15-25 px high. The best text on the car. Single-stroke along the letter centre lines reads as handwriting.

of-engineering.name: 'of Engineering' lettering
of-engineering.note: Thinner white on black; every letter legible.

side-names-rear.name: Three names ahead of the lettering
side-names-rear.note: Readable at 3x, about 8 px high. Real people's names: on phone they would be noise and on desktop tiny. Baseline scribble only, or nothing.

side-mark.name: Small pale mark on the black side
side-mark.note: A few px. Unknown. Could be a fastener or a decal. Leave out.

side-plate.name: White 219 plate on the side panel
side-plate.note: Lower-left edge is the tyre overlapping the plate, not the plate's own edge.

side-plate-2.name: Numeral 2 on the side plate
side-plate-2.note: Heavy black figure, about 5 px stroke. Its foot is hidden by the front tyre.

side-plate-crease.name: Soft crease across the side plate
side-plate-crease.note: A tonal fold line. Desktop only.

cockpit-rail-upper.name: Cockpit rail, upper edge
cockpit-rail-upper.note: Lit grey round rail. Current stroke sits on it.

cockpit-rail-lower.name: Cockpit rail, lower edge
cockpit-rail-lower.note: Not in the current drawing. Gives the rail its thickness.

side-panel-black.name: Black side panel behind the number plate
side-panel-black.note: A flat black mass with no surface edges. Candidate for hatching.

helmet-outline.name: Helmet silhouette
helmet-outline.note: White against grass, black box and neck.

visor-seal.name: White seal lip below the visor
visor-seal.note: White on white; only its shadow side reads. Desktop only.

nose-slot.name: Small slot at the helmet front

helmet-badge.name: Oval badge on the helmet
helmet-badge.note: Draw the oval only, no letters.

helmet-top-vent.name: Vent slit on top of the helmet

helmet-forehead-mark.name: Small metallic mark on the forehead
helmet-forehead-mark.note: Grey mark. One tick at most.

helmet-side-pod.name: Side pod and visor pivot area
helmet-side-pod.note: Irregular shape with a black hole at (1449, 565). Outline loosely; do not imply a mechanism.

helmet-side-decal.name: Small decal low on the helmet side

neck.name: Black neck, under the helmet
neck.note: Black against the pale collar. A beige band crosses it at (1417-1432, 622-638); unidentified.

collar-near.name: Near shoulder silhouette against asphalt
collar-near.note: Blotchy blue, white and black suit pattern; the edge is clear, the interior is not simple.

suit-pale-panel.name: Pale blue suit panels on the near chest
suit-pale-panel.note: Pattern on the suit. One or two strokes. Black patches around it are shadow and pattern mixed.

harness-strap-1.name: Red strap, centre chest
harness-strap-1.note: Saturated red webbing. Two long edges. Identity as harness is inferred from colour, position and buckle-like block; nothing on the page should label it.

harness-strap-5.name: Red strap running to the far shoulder

sleeve-band.name: Near sleeve, outer curve with black band
sleeve-band.note: White suit with black stripe. Reads as a rounded shoulder or upper arm.

sleeve-inner-loop.name: Black strap loop on the sleeve

blue-cuff.name: Blue cuff or band
blue-cuff.note: Saturated blue band. Do not call it a glove or a cuff on the page.

pale-wedge.name: Pale wedge above the rail
pale-wedge.note: Sleeve, glove or thigh. Cannot tell which.

blue-object.name: Blue object beside the far shoulder

grey-wedge-far.name: Grey wedge behind the far shoulder
grey-wedge-far.note: The current stroke is named shoulder-far, but the crop reads as a grey sheet behind the driver, not the shoulder. The stroke is fine; the name is doubtful.

dark-pack-right.name: Rounded dark shape right of the sleeve
dark-pack-right.note: Black on near black. Could be seat, arm shadow or a pad.

steering-wheel.name: Steering wheel
steering-wheel.note: No wheel rim, spoke or hub is visible anywhere in the cockpit area. Do not draw one.

front-hoop.name: Front hoop
front-hoop.note: Nothing in the cockpit opening can be identified as a front hoop. Do not draw one.

arch-outer.name: Hoop arch, outer edge
arch-outer.note: Black tube against grass and track. Current drawing has one centre line for the whole tube.

arch-inner.name: Hoop arch, inner edge
arch-inner.note: Above the lamp it borders the green patch. Gives the arch real thickness.

arch-stalk.name: Short black stalk on top of the arch
arch-stalk.note: Sits on the apex. Above y 412 it joins a dark shape at (1461-1495, 396-412) against a dark treeline, which may be background. Draw the stalk only if the owner confirms it is on the car; it is an unknown part.

arch-top-object.name: Dark shape above the stalk
arch-top-object.note: Left and lower edges read against the pale rocks behind, with a bright stripe at (1476-1480, 397-402). Top merges into the dark treeline. It may be a part mounted on the stalk or something in the background. Ask the owner; do not draw it from this photo.

green-patch.name: Green patch inside the arch, above the lamp
green-patch.note: Measured hue 113-116 degrees against 75-82 for the grass around the hoop, so it is not grass seen through the arch. Has a pale hot spot at (1476-1484, 438-444). May be a green lens. Identity unknown. Its upper line is the arch inner edge, so draw no extra part.

lamp-housing.name: Black housing around the amber lens
lamp-housing.note: Black against grass below and green patch above.

lamp-lens.name: Amber lamp lens
lamp-lens.note: Rounded rectangle. Pattern inside is not resolved. Current name says TSAL; nothing visible proves that, but no drawing labels it.

lamp-lens-ribs.name: Texture inside the lens
lamp-lens-ribs.note: Grid-like blotches, likely LED pattern plus compression. Not countable. Do not draw individual LEDs.

lamp-screw.name: Bright fastener glint at the housing corner

left-leg-shroud-outer.name: Wide black leg left of the arch, outer edge
left-leg-shroud-outer.note: Wide black shape, about 20 px, going behind the helmet.

diag-tube.name: Thin tube from the arch to behind the helmet

red-block.name: Red block on the thin tube

thin-rod.name: Thin horizontal rod to the column

pink-sleeve.name: Pink sleeve on the right leg
pink-sleeve.note: Pale pink. Unknown part. Two sides.

column-left.name: Wide black column, left edge
column-left.note: Lower part borders the pale strips. Current hoop stroke runs one line down this column.

column-right.name: Wide black column, right edge
column-right.note: Against grass above y 552, against the pale panel below.

column-mid.name: Column, internal vertical division
column-mid.note: Darker left half, greyer right half. May be two members side by side. Do not imply which.

column-bands.name: Short dark wrap marks on the column
column-bands.note: Short cross ticks, visible in the gamma crop. Could be tape or joints. Number and spacing are as seen; desktop only.

column-below-rail.name: Column continuing below the rail
column-below-rail.note: Black on black. Right edge only, where lit clutter sits behind it.

brace.name: Long diagonal brace, centre line
brace.note: Black tube against grass and asphalt. Row profiles give a dark span about 7-11 px wide (y 560: x 1548-1556; y 600: x 1570-1576; y 640: x 1585-1596). Current stroke lies inside it.

brace-outer-edge.name: Brace, outer edge against asphalt
brace-outer-edge.note: From row profiles. Gives the brace thickness on desktop.

brace-inner-edge.name: Brace, inner edge
brace-inner-edge.note: From row profiles. Lost in the clutter below about y 645.

orange-tab.name: Orange tab at the brace top

brace-tab.name: Small dark hook off the brace

black-box-top.name: Black padded box behind the helmet, top edge
black-box-top.note: Against grass. Identity (head restraint or seat back) is inferred.

black-box-right.name: Black padded box, right edge
black-box-right.note: Against pale strip and black column. Partly lost in the column's darkness.

pale-strip-upper.name: Pale strip between box and column, upper
pale-strip-upper.note: Pale blue-grey, same material as the panel on the other side.

pale-strip-lower.name: Pale strip between box and column, lower

pale-panel.name: Pale panel between column and brace
pale-panel.note: Top edge and the thin black strut that bounds it on the right. Identity (firewall or similar) is not provable.

panel-dot.name: Dark dot on the pale panel
panel-dot.note: One small mark. Hole, fastener or marking. Desktop only.

box-top.name: Dark box behind the hoop, top edge

box-labels.name: Pale marks on the box face
box-labels.note: Pale blotches in loose rows. Not legible, not countable. Do not imply labels or connectors. Two or three short ticks on desktop at most.

rail-behind-hoop.name: Thin grey tube behind the column
rail-behind-hoop.note: Lit grey. Continues the line of the cockpit rail.

brace-inner-lit.name: Lit streak inside the brace shadow

tube-a.name: Short dark tube below the box, left

tube-b.name: Short dark tube below the box, right

tube-e.name: Thick dark member into the beam

beam-top.name: Black flat beam, upper edge
beam-top.note: Against asphalt on its right half. Current rear-rail-top rides on this from x 1590, and is about 3 px off at its right end.

rail-top-left-half.name: Current rear-rail-top, its left half
rail-top-left-half.note: This part of the current stroke crosses the pink wire bundle; no continuous tube shows here. Replace with what is actually visible.

diag-to-tyre.name: Diagonal tube to the rear tyre, top

arm-upper.name: Long straight member at y 706
arm-upper.note: Pale on its left half, black on its right. One straight tube.

line-b.name: Dark line under the long member
line-b.note: Dark on asphalt. Tube or cast shadow.

line-c.name: Diagonal dark line, mid window
line-c.note: Dark on asphalt. Tube or cast shadow.

rod-lit.name: Long bright rod at y 731-739
rod-lit.note: Bright rod. Current rear-wb-lower is about parallel, a few px off; check it.

line-d.name: Dark diagonal rising to the tyre

shadow-streaks-rear.name: Parallel dark streaks on the asphalt under the rear frame
shadow-streaks-rear.note: Run down to the right at ground level with soft ends. Probably cast shadows of the tubes above, not tubes. Draw as shadow marks at most, never as suspension.

white-junction.name: White Y-shaped glints
white-junction.note: Bright. Looks like a joint between thin rods. Identity unknown.

white-lump.name: White lump with rust-coloured area
white-lump.note: Bright and irregular. Unknown. Outline loosely.

rear-clutter.name: Unresolved parts, x 1570-1625, y 690-735
rear-clutter.note: Dense small glints and blacks. No continuous lines. A person would suggest it with 8-12 short marks, which must be marked as impression.

wires-orange.name: Orange and pink wire bundle
wires-orange.note: Individual strands partly readable. Colour suggests HV cable, but nothing proves it. Strands are approximate.

ribbed-lens-left.name: Pale ribbed shape, left outline
ribbed-lens-left.note: Thin pale lines forming a lens shape. Identity unknown. Do not call it a motor, cover or hose.

ribbed-lens-ribs.name: Pale ribbed shape, inner lines
ribbed-lens-ribs.note: At least two inner lines. Could be more.

rod-white-front.name: Bright thin rod beside the front tyre
rod-white-front.note: Sharp bright line. Identity unknown. It could be a pushrod or a tie rod: do not assert either.

comb-bits.name: Small comb-like parts low near the tyre

lower-rail-top.name: Lower side rail, lit upper surface
lower-rail-top.note: Three lit segments with gaps. Current rear-rail-low runs about here.

lower-rail-under.name: Lower side rail, underside against asphalt
lower-rail-under.note: Hard black to asphalt edge. Not in the current drawing.

front-glint-long.name: Long bright glint ahead of the front tyre
front-glint-long.note: 2-3 px wide, 36 px long, the largest in this area. A lit tube edge, but nothing connects it. Do not extend it to the wheel or the body.

front-glint-small.name: Small glints
front-glint-small.note: Isolated 5-20 px specks. Not a tube path.

front-wishbones.name: Front wishbones as continuous tubes
front-wishbones.note: Confirmed: only disconnected glints in near-zero black. Luminance between them is 0-2 of 255. No inboard or outboard ends visible. Do not draw them. tools/hero-drawing/README.md is right.

front-parallel-lines.name: Two parallel dark lines on lit asphalt
front-parallel-lines.note: Sharp, on lit asphalt, same direction as the rear shadow streaks. May be tube silhouettes or cast shadows. Draw as shadow marks, not suspension.

front-lens-lit.name: Lit lens-shaped patch
front-lens-lit.note: Asphalt or a lit part; unclear.

fw-silhouette.name: Front tyre, outer silhouette
fw-silhouette.note: Right and top are clear. On the left, the last 30 px of the current stroke (below about y 830) has max luminance 0-2 within 8 px on either side (dark_regions.json): no edge is there, so that end is guesswork and should be cut back. The plate's lower-left edge is the same line.

fw-tread-sidewall.name: Tread to sidewall boundary
fw-tread-sidewall.note: Visible as a tone change. Below y 860 the left side is in black.

fw-rib-1.name: Moulded rib on the sidewall, outer

fw-rib-2.name: Moulded rib on the sidewall, inner

fw-rim-lip.name: Rim outer lip
fw-rim-lip.note: Upper left is bright and clear. Right side, x 1470-1488 and y 810-870, is deep black: the ellipse there is a fit, not a seen edge. Say so in provenance.

fw-rim-inner-arc-a.name: Inner rim arc, lower right
fw-rim-inner-arc-a.note: Bright. Not in the current drawing.

fw-rim-upper-arc.name: Rim inner arc, upper left
fw-rim-upper-arc.note: Bright curved highlight just inside the lip.

fw-spoke-right.name: Lit wheel arm, right of centre
fw-spoke-right.note: One clear lit arm. The wheel's spoke count is not countable: at most 3-4 arms are visible, and they mix with parts behind. Do not draw a symmetric spoke pattern.

fw-lit-mass.name: Bright irregular mass inside the wheel
fw-lit-mass.note: Sunlit parts seen through the wheel. Could be hub, upright or brake parts. The owner has a brake project, so do NOT outline it as a rotor. One loose contour at most.

fw-hub-hole.name: Dark hole left of centre
fw-hub-hole.note: Black gap. Not a wheel centre: the wheel centre mark at (1449, 847) is a fit.

fw-bead-lower.name: Lit arc below the rim, on the lower sidewall
fw-bead-lower.note: Soft arc visible with a mild lift only. Flange or bead; do not name it.

fw-hoosier-upper.name: 'Hoosier' lettering, upper-left arc
fw-hoosier-upper.note: White moulded or painted letters. H, o, o, s, i, e, r readable in order, H about 18 px high, others 8-12 px.

fw-hoosier-lower.name: 'Hoosier' lettering, lower-right arc
fw-hoosier-lower.note: Letters partly merge with bright asphalt at the right; last letters thin. Harder to threshold than the upper arc.

fw-grain.name: Speckle on the front tread
fw-grain.note: Rubber grain. A person might add a few dots; low value.

fw-contact.name: Front tyre contact patch
fw-contact.note: Black tyre on black shadow. Luminance 0. Only the shadow's outer edge exists.

uprights.name: Uprights, hubs as parts
uprights.note: No upright or hub can be told apart on either wheel. Do not draw them.

rw-silhouette.name: Rear tyre, outer silhouette
rw-silhouette.note: All clear, except below y 765 on the left, where it joins its shadow.

rw-tread-sidewall.name: Tread to sidewall boundary, top
rw-tread-sidewall.note: Soft tone change, with a few streaks at (1700-1730, 688-700). Not in the current drawing.

rw-sidewall-lower.name: Sidewall boundary, lower left
rw-sidewall-lower.note: Pale band against black, seen only in the gamma crop. The stroke would be a stretch at phone scale.

rw-rim-ellipse.name: Rim lip, full ellipse
rw-rim-ellipse.note: Upper and lower-left are seen, right side is in black and is a fit.

rw-glints.name: Glints inside the rear wheel
rw-glints.note: Small bright specks in loose arcs. Could be spokes or bolts. Not a pattern to complete.

rw-hoosier-upper.name: 'Hoosier' lettering, upper arc
rw-hoosier-upper.note: Readable. H at lower left is the largest.

rw-hoosier-lower.name: 'Hoosier' lettering, lower arc
rw-hoosier-lower.note: Letters small, merging at the edges.

rw-grain.name: Worn grain patch on the tread
rw-grain.note: Mottled rubber, brighter than the rest. Real surface wear. A few stipple dots could suggest it; do not imply a tread pattern.

far-front-crown.name: Far-side front tyre crown
far-front-crown.note: Dark on grey. Lower part is hidden by the nose.

far-rear-tyre.name: Far-side rear tyre
far-rear-tyre.note: No crown or sidewall can be identified in any crop, even with a lift. Its expected place is behind the dark box and frame clutter. Do not draw it.

shadow-nose-tip.name: Body shadow, tip
shadow-nose-tip.note: Not in the current drawing. Soft-cornered.

shadow-nose-upper.name: Body shadow, upper edge to the nose
shadow-nose-upper.note: Not in the current drawing. Closes the shadow under the nose.

shadow-asphalt-wedge.name: Asphalt wedge between body shadow and tyre shadow
shadow-asphalt-wedge.note: Lit asphalt under the car. Not in the current drawing. Top run has broken patches.

shadow-rail.name: Thin shadow under the lower rail
shadow-rail.note: Hard to separate from the rail's own underside.
